$comment: Desktop compatibility sweep round 4: the next 30 Chrome Web Store extensions by install count after the top 30 of round 1, the 30 of next30.json and the 30 of next30-round3.json (ranks 91-120; the harness at /tmp/zen-compat reads this list; manifests under the project store internal/extensions/next30-round4/). Counts are the store detail pages' rounded figures read 2026-09-20; ties inside one rounded bucket are ordered by the page's rating count. Candidates came from the store's category listings and about 9,200 detail pages probed across rounds 3 and 4. Not ranked: themes, Chrome Apps (Google Classroom) and organisation-login-only items (Endpoint Verification, ClassLink OneClick, Clever, Mobility Print, Lightspeed Insight Agent, Okta Browser Plugin, Trellix Endpoint Security Web Control, LearnPlatform for Students, OpenText Content Server Browser Web Extension).
